_meta.what: the measures study and the BLEI paper’s other measures for release 2: for each row (and year), the mean over the runs and the 10th and 90th percentile across them

study.units: dollars a month in today's prices; shares in %; days of basic living; EPPM a ratio and its parts shares of the twins' total

measures.units: edc* and fbsAbove* in %; fbs50Med dollars a month; cost dollars per adult a year; epPY, fgt0PY in %; fgt1PY the poverty gap in % of the line
measures.ipbi: from the means over seeds, as release 1's panel (harness.js testbed release): unhoused person-years avoided per 1,000 adults a year, homelessness costs low and high (AVOID_HOMELESS), prisons and hospital and psychiatric stays (avoidWide, main and high), each row against the no-programme row
measures.d: paired difference row - no programme over the seeds, mean and 95% interval (harness.js tbDiff)

r2.rows: harness.js r2FreezePair: no programme, C2.2 and the release design (release 2's main row)

selfCheck.ref: every engine key of every row equals release 2's part M (r2-m-ref-20-50bc51d/shard-0000.json.gz, engine 50bc51d): 2979 row-keys, 1489500 values, seeds 1..500; seed 1's adults add up to the engine's yearly shares
selfCheck.adv: every engine key of every row equals release 2's part M (r2-m-adv-20-50bc51d/shard-0000.json.gz, engine 50bc51d): 2979 row-keys, 1489500 values, seeds 1..500; seed 1's adults add up to the engine's yearly shares

wgini.what: the weighted wealth Gini at the end of the last year (gz debts counted as zero, gn debts kept), from release 2’s own stored results; the plain per-adult Gini in series (giniW, giniWnet and their N forms) is not valid with the top tail on, and the page does not show it
